1.name: Dark Prince

effects.text: You may not advance, upgrade, or use {time} effects.

1.text: {passive} You may not advance, upgrade, or use {time} effects. {activated} Spend {sword}{sword}{sword}{sword}{sword} to defeat ({flip}).
1.helpText:
VERSION NOTE: Previous versions of this card prevented ALL playing of cards. This updated version only prevents playing cards through the advance action.
While Dark Prince is in play, you may not advance (the action that plays 2 more cards from your deck), you may not upgrade, and you may not use Time [time] effects. Usually, this means you need to pass, but you may use activated [activated] effects and passive [passive] effects before that. At the end of the turn, this is discarded just like all other cards.

description:
VERSION NOTE: Previous versions prevented ALL playing of cards. This updated version only prevents playing cards through the advance action.
He's just... awful. But defeating him will surely be impressive!
NOTE: The Dark Prince does NOT stay in play. The infinity symbol means his effect is active while he is in play, but he is discard like all other cards at the end of the turn.
